articles.image_title: Unkrautvernichter Glyphosat: WASHINGTON, DC - APRIL 27: "The People vs the Poison" protesters gather at the US Supreme Court on April 27, 2026 in Washington, DC. (Photo by Tasos Katopodis/Getty Images)
